narrative_purpose: Capture the essence of the chapter: the tension between biological growth and immense structural power.
subject: A majestic full-length view of a tall, single-stave Na'vi longbow, resting diagonally in an open clearing of a bioluminescent rainforest. The weapon is three meters long, carved from an unbroken curve of deep brown heartwood, reinforced along its back with a sleek layer of dark banshee wing-vane chitin, and strung with a taut braided gut cord.
scene: A peaceful dark forest glade illuminated by soft cyan bioluminescence and drifting spore motes, with the elegant bow as the sole heroic centerpiece.
camera: Medium distance, clear descriptive view, level angle.
light: Bioluminescent key light highlighting structural details, deep teal-indigo ambient shadows, volumetric haze in the background.
palette: Cool Pandora base (Void indigo, Deep teal-indigo, Ocean teal, Pandora cyan, Living teal) with sparing Biolum magenta or Ember amber accents for key structural features.
style: Original speculative-biology painterly illustration, naturalist plate energy, detailed structural cutaway.
detail_level: High structural detail, precise geometry, visible material textures (grain, fibres, layers).
composition: Clear focal subject, generous negative space of haze and shadow, no clutter.
consistency_notes: Follow STYLE BIBLE. Ensure painterly feel, no 3D render plastic.
negative_prompt: text, numbers, captions, labels, watermarks, signatures, arrows, leader lines, UI chrome, flat-design infographic, textbook clip art, CAD, 3D render, photographic, lens flare, CGI plastic.
